title: A first draft, not a blank page
sub: AI and continuous architecture: an agent drafts a first design for a new service from the industry's reference models and the organisation's own documents, every element with its source and unconfirmed; the owners say what's missing and what's wrong, and only what they confirm becomes the model.
howto: Clay and dawn are Babylon, over 2,600 years ago: the old foundation of its temple-tower, and the form it was rebuilt in. In the present, a teal orb is the map agent. Its draft is paper: notes pinned to a wall, each with its source clipped to it and a half-filled dot, unconfirmed. A note an owner confirms turns to glass, with their name and the date. Blue is the network and rose is retail, with the wall between them; gold marks owners and the business side, cyan the technical side.
